expectations.text: Classifies copper as a Group II pollutant (toxic metal) with a technical review criterion of 1.2x the limit (20% over)
expectations.evidence: Copper is a metal, Group II (1.2x); notes group should be confirmed

expectations.text: Concludes 25% over in 2 of 6 months MEETS the TRC, so the effluent criterion for SNC is met
expectations.evidence: 1.25x in 2 of 6 months meets TRC ("probable TRC SNC", conditional on Group II)

expectations.text: Notes the chronic criterion (4 of 6 months) is not met by two months
expectations.evidence: Chronic needs 4 of 6; 2 does not meet

expectations.text: Says the DMR filed 45 days late is a reporting violation that can independently count toward SNC (30+ days late)
expectations.evidence: 45-day-late DMR is a reporting violation counting toward SNC (flags 30-day as [G])

expectations.text: States that SNC status is assigned by EPA/the state and the permittee's own reading is indicative
expectations.evidence: SNC assigned by EPA/state; assessment indicative
